# SIG Docs release day support

Post in `#sig-docs` and raise it in the SIG Docs meeting about two weeks
before release day.

```text
Hi @sig-docs-leads

The <future release> release is scheduled for <day>, <date> at <time> <time zone>.

Could someone from SIG Docs be the point of contact for the Docs Lead on release day? Specifically:
1. Release day support: help with the Netlify configuration updates and the release blog post publication.
2. Generated docs status: please confirm that the Kubernetes API reference, the kubectl documentation and the components documentation are ready.

Thank you!
```
